about: Six fixed views of ONE race, the same for every specialist and for the before / after comparison. The race is the real game engine (mxwar/demo-engine.js, the same drive as game.js) through the 3D view on the harness page (mxwar/demo.html): the 2026 Supercross season, round 1 Anaheim, the Main with 22 riders, the person 'YOU' among them (seat 12), the red plate on seat 0, engine seed 22. t is race seconds after the gate drop (the view's clock T; t < 0 = at the gate, before the drop); the harness steps whole 1/60 s ticks on a virtual clock with a seeded Math.random, so the same plan gives the same frames. Cameras: a rider rig {seat, back, up, side, aim, fov} (metres along / across the rider's heading, + side = the rider's right, up above the dirt; seat 'you' | 'lead' | 'crash' | N | {rank:k}) or a world pose {eye, target, fov} (x east, y up, z south; the stadium floor is x -67.5..67.5, z -32..44; the whoops lane is z -5, the big jump z 19, the gate (-54.6, 33)). Run them with tools/shots.js; every tool is documented in tools/README.md. [2026-10-17 integrate:merge: B2, B2b and R2 moved out of the stands (director note D2); the previous plan is bookmarks.v1-before-D2.json]

race.track: sx-modern-v832 (the generated Stadium template: the round has no traced layout), 518 m

bookmarks.name: cover chase
bookmarks.why: The cover's framing: low behind a rider (3.5 m back, 1.5 m up, 70 degrees vertical), exiting the east berm (hairpin 3, lap 1) with riders ahead and the stadium and its lights in frame. Lap 1, seat 15 (plate 45, 4th in the running order).

bookmarks.name: stadium wide
bookmarks.why: An elevated broadcast view from the lower stands (south-east corner, 6.7 m above the seats): the whole course and the pack across the floor, the far packed stands and the light rigs in the top half (Reference_Crops/broadcast_overview). FOV 48. (MOVED from the eye (0,33,92), which sits inside the new upper deck: see "moved".)

moved.why: D2: the old eye (0,33,92) is INSIDE the new south upper deck (bowlY = 32.4 there): a black band over the lower 40% of the frame. The new eye stands 6.7 m above the seats under it (bowlY(22,63) = 11.3), oblique over the floor like the CEO broadcast reference crop. The BEFORE frame was re-captured from the base commit ac4b1bf with this same pose.

bookmarks.name: whoops
bookmarks.why: Trackside beside the whoops lane (15 whoops, s 337-393, z -5): the first-lap pack skims them head-on toward the lens, the flagger's stand behind.

bookmarks.name: jump
bookmarks.why: A low side view from the far side of the start straight: six riders in the air over the big triple / tabletop (s 68-104, z 19) on lap 2, the stadium behind them.

bookmarks.name: gate
bookmarks.why: The start gate and the launch into turn 1: 1.6 s after the drop, the pads down, 22 riders pulling away from the gate (x -54.6, z 33) toward the first corner, seen from behind and the side.

bookmarks.name: crash
bookmarks.why: A crash with the yellow flag: lap 2, the whoops (s 373). The double-war loser (seat 19) is thrown over the bars and tumbles, the bike slides, dust, the marshal waves the yellow flag at the edge of the track, the field rides past.

extras.name: cover chase, you
extras.why: The same moment on the person's own rider.

extras.why: Lower and closer, as in the cover.

extras.name: stadium wide, oblique

extras.name: jump, first lap
extras.why: Lap 1: the whole field airborne over the big jump at once.

extras.name: gate, front

extras.name: gate, before the drop
extras.why: The riders on the gate, before the drop.

extras.name: crash, rider lying
extras.why: A beat later: the rider lies in the whoops, the bike on its side.

extras.name: crash, low front
extras.why: Low from the front: the rider on the ground, the marshal's flag at the left.

recordings.name: cinematic chase
recordings.why: The cover chase camera on seat 15 (plate 45) from hairpin 3 through the whoops: roost, suspension, the pack ahead.

recordings.name: stadium broadcast
recordings.why: The elevated south-east broadcast camera (FOV 48, 6.7 m above the seats) panning with the race leader for 5 s, then a cut to the view's own director (its trackside / chase / jump cameras): what a viewer of the real game is shown.
